hypothesis.method: Neuro-Symbolic Feedback Loops with Human-AI Co-Creation in Latent Space
hypothesis.problem: Generative AI models produce coherent but statistically plausible content that lacks verifiable factual grounding and causal consistency
hypothesis.goal: Dynamically align model outputs with real-world evidence through interpretable, feedback-driven symbolic constraints

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Express it as three short phrases: a Method (the technique to be used), a Problem (the problem to be addressed), and a Goal (the property to be improved).
